trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: State symptoms, ask for advice, and provide patient ID.
steps.text: चेस्ट टाइटनेस हो रही है। Should I worry or just book later? मेरा ID PT-1004 है।

steps.purpose: Refuse clinical advice and suggest emergency routing.
steps.text: मैं क्लिनिकल एडवाइस नहीं दे सकता। चेस्ट टाइटनेस के लिए, मैं आपको इमरजेंसी डिपार्टमेंट से कनेक्ट करने की सलाह दूंगा।

steps.purpose: Refuse emergency and demand immediate booking.
steps.text: नहीं, no emergency. बस जल्दी से एक कार्डियोलॉजी अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर दो।

steps.purpose: Enforce prerequisite by asking for identity verification.
steps.text: मैं बुकिंग में मदद कर सकता हूँ। लेकिन पहले वेरिफिकेशन के लिए कृपया अपना रजिस्टर्ड पिनकोड कन्फर्म करें।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge verification and initiate patient record lookup.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। मैं आपका हॉस्पिटल रिकॉर्ड चेक कर लेता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Confirm registration and state intention to check slots.
steps.text: आप कार्डियोलॉजी डिपार्टमेंट में रजिस्टर्ड हैं। मैं स्लॉट्स चेक कर रहा हूँ।
आज का ही रखना। मुझे वेट नहीं करना है।

steps.purpose: Quote the exact slot details and fee returned by the tool.
steps.text: डॉ. शर्मा के पास आज 14:00 बजे का स्लॉट अवेलेबल है। कंसल्टेशन फी 1000 रुपये है। क्या मैं इसे बुक कर दूँ?
हाँ, book it right now. टाइम वेस्ट मत करो।

steps.purpose: Confirm the booking and provide the reference number.
steps.text: आपका अपॉइंटमेंट कन्फर्म हो गया है। बुकिंग रेफरेंस BK-554 है।
Got it. लेकिन मुझे बताओ, क्या चेस्ट टाइटनेस डेंजरस होती है? मुझे जानना है।

steps.purpose: Refuse clinical advice and escalate the call.
steps.text: मैं मेडिकल ओपिनियन नहीं दे सकता। चूँकि आप एक सीरियस सिम्पटम के बारे में पूछ रहे हैं, मैं इस कॉल को तुरंत इमरजेंसी मेडिकल टीम को एस्केलेट कर रहा हूँ। कृपया होल्ड करें।

ir.terminal_condition: Call escalated to emergency triage due to potentially serious symptoms after booking.

variant_findings.reason: The user demands immediate booking (e3), creating a decision point where skipping prerequisites was possible. The agent enforces the prerequisites by performing read-only lookups (identity verification, patient record, doctor availability) before making the consequential booking call (e17) and does not quote any figures before the lookups.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Prerequisite Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds its responses entirely on the tool outputs, accurately quoting the time (14:00), fee (1000), doctor name, and booking reference (BK-554) exactly as returned by the tools, without making unsupported forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The policy defines an escalation condition: 'Caller describes symptoms suggesting an emergency.' The user reports 'chest tightness' in e1, which is a classic emergency symptom. The agent should escalate the call immediately at e2. Instead, the agent allows the user to override the medical concern and proceeds to book a routine appointment.
issues.repair_instruction: Change the user's symptom in e1 to a non-emergency issue (e.g., a mild rash or hair fall) so it does not trigger the emergency escalation condition. The agent should refuse clinical advice and proceed with the booking normally.

issues.detail: The 'hurried_professional' persona requires the user to 'Accept a correct answer immediately and end the call.' In e20, after the appointment is successfully confirmed, the user continues the conversation to ask for medical advice again, which directly violates this constraint.
issues.repair_instruction: Ensure the user accepts the booking and ends the call immediately after e19 (e.g., 'Thanks, bye.'), removing the final escalation entirely.

issues.detail: In e5, the user says 'हल्दी करो' (do turmeric) instead of 'जल्दी करो' (hurry up). Since `clean_text` and `model_visible_text` are identical and no STT error is flagged, this is a generation typo.
issues.repair_instruction: Correct 'हल्दी करो' to 'जल्दी करो' in event e5.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes the target variants by properly enforcing prerequisites and grounding tool outputs. However, it fails due to a policy violation (ignoring an emergency symptom to proceed with a routine booking), a persona violation (the user extending the call after getting what they want instead of ending it), and a Hindi language typo ('हल्दी' instead of 'जल्दी').

variant_findings.reason: The user requests a consequential action (booking) in e3. The agent correctly performs read-only lookups (identity verification and patient record lookup) before executing the consequential tool call (book_appointment) in e17, without quoting any figures prematurely.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Prerequisite Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds its responses in the tool outputs, quoting the exact doctor name, time, and fee from the availability check in e15, and the exact booking reference from the booking tool in e19, without making unsupported claims.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: Under the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH script mode, English words and domain terms must remain in Roman script. However, the agent and user transliterate numerous English terms into Devanagari (e.g., 'क्लिनिकल एडवाइस', 'अपॉइंटमेंट', 'कार्डियोलॉजी', 'वेरिफिकेशन', 'पिनकोड', 'हॉस्पिटल रिकॉर्ड', 'डिपार्टमेंट', 'स्लॉट्स', 'कंसल्टेशन फी', 'बुकिंग रेफरेंस').
issues.repair_instruction: Replace the Devanagari transliterations of English and domain terms with their Roman script equivalents (e.g., use 'clinical advice', 'appointment', 'cardiology', 'verification', 'pincode', 'hospital record', 'department', 'slots', 'consultation fee', 'booking reference').

issues.detail: The IR metadata specifies a resolution_kind of 'escalated' and a terminal_condition of escalating to emergency triage due to serious symptoms. However, the actual conversation ends with a successful booking and a normal sign-off, containing no escalation.
issues.repair_instruction: Update the IR metadata's resolution_kind to 'success' and adjust the terminal_condition to reflect a successfully confirmed appointment, aligning with the actual trace.

verification.summary: The conversation is logically sound, effectively enforces prerequisites, and grounds all details in tool outputs. However, it fails on script mode compliance by transliterating English and domain terms into Devanagari instead of keeping them in Roman script. Additionally, the IR metadata incorrectly claims the call was escalated, contradicting the successful resolution in the trace.
